svg.aria-label: Shared L2, four cores through one cache
svg.text: Shared L2, four cores through one cache
12 MiB, 12 ways, 8192 sets, 128 B lines in two 64 B halves. Physically indexed with two hashed bits. Inclusive of the L1Ds.
spare lines an L1D still holds
3 MiB beside each core; 17 clk inner, more across
E cores may use this L2 while the P cores sleep
